programme.desc: Rajesh, a superintendent of the police, is happy to meet his old friend Shekar in Goa, unaware that he is a smuggler who is involved in a spree of illegal activities.

programme.title: Aakhri Ghulam
programme.desc: Bheema, his father Dinu and generations of their family have been slaves of the wealthy Thakurs. One day, he challenges their authority and invites trouble for himself in the process.

programme.title: Mela
programme.desc: Best mates Kishen and Shankar decide to help village belle Roopa avenge her family's death, but their friendship is tested in the process.

programme.title: Karishma Kudrat Ka
programme.desc: Widower Vijay lives in a village with his family. He unwittingly makes an enemy in Lala and a bandit, Bhagad, who conspire and throw him out of the village. But Vijay soon returns as a changed man.

programme.title: Jigri Dost
programme.desc: Shobha prepares to marry an advocate named Anand as arranged by her father. However, she secretly follows him one day and is shocked to see him in the arms of another woman.

programme.title: Blood Relation

programme.title: Sweekar Kiya Maine

programme.title: Main Intequam Loonga
programme.desc: Kumar learns that his father, a national level boxing champion, was killed when he refused to lose a fight. He vows to annihilate his father's killers, unaware that he may face tragic consequences.

programme.title: Antim Nyay
programme.desc: Jay Singh encounters Seema while struggling to seek justice for his deceased father. As the couple attempts to live a happy life, unforeseen circumstances invite more troubles.

programme.title: Krishna Arjun

programme.title: Pardesi
programme.desc: Myna rescues Ajay, who is bitten by a snake, but he loses his memory. He begins a new life with Myna and her family and the two fall in love, much to her secret lover's outrage.

programme.desc: Big Cat Planet: Familiar species and behaviours take on new drama, with revelations that reaffirm why big cats remain nature's most formidable predators. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: Bizarre Animal Friends
programme.desc: A Pig and his Pooch: A look at the most surprising animal friendships, including the world's smallest stallion and his canine pal and two rhinos that are guarded by sheep. (S5, ep 1) 7+

programme.title: Secrets Of The Zoo: Columbus
programme.desc: Bringing Up Baby!: Doctors rush to save a cougar with an abscess, a miracle baby okapi gets a check-up and 2,000 animals come in for the winter. 7+ (S1, ep 6)

programme.title: Ultimate Airport Dubai
programme.desc: Staff confront a passenger who's travelling on a fake passport. And, six years after it was bought, the first Emirates Airlines Airbus is given a thorough maintenance check. (S2, ep 7)

programme.title: Yukon Vet
programme.desc: Caribou Down: At the Yukon Wildlife Preserve, Michelle examines growths on a young caribou. But things take a turn when the drugged caribou challenges a bull to a scrap. (S1, ep 4) 7+

programme.title: Secrets Of The Zoo: Columbus
programme.desc: Love is a Cheetah Cub: The zoo goes wild for three cute cheetah cubs. But it's not all good news. Staff fight to save Arctic fox Anana, and monkey Finnick needs emergency care. (S2, ep 1)

programme.title: Tiger Shark Terror
programme.desc: Determined to find out whether sharks really do feed at night, scientists fit tiger sharks with cameras to determine how their behaviour changes when the sun goes down.

programme.title: Shark Eat Shark
programme.desc: Enrico Gennari and Lacey Williams lead a team of experts into a bay off South Africa's southern coast to capture conclusive evidence of sharks eating other sharks. U.

programme.title: Life Below Zero: First Alaskans
programme.desc: A Moose Can Feed a Family: As the youngest members of these communities take on the responsibility of hunting, they face the challenges of survival. 12+. (S3, ep 19)

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: Fishy Business: Bjorn battles heavy snowfall as he deals with frozen fuel tanks and troublesome reindeer. In the south, a truck loses its axle on the icy hillside. 7+

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship hourly news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Tradition Inspires A Green Future
programme.desc: Aditya Sharma seeks a sustainable balance between protecting the planet and meeting consumer demand for clothing - he explores a Japanese tradition in the hopes of finding inspiration.

programme.title: Impacts: Climates Change the World
programme.desc: Rising temperatures due to climate change have affected the behaviour of bees - with fewer bees and shorter pollination periods, a threat is posed to agriculture that could lead to a food crisis.

programme.title: Carving the Spirit of Fishermen
programme.desc: Hokkaido / Takeya Takayuki (Model Maker): Fishing boats in the herring industry that thrived here until the 1950s featured swirling decorations that made a big impression on Hokkaido native Takeya.

programme.title: Where We Call Home
programme.desc: We meet two Americans who preserve Japanese traditions; Chris Hinds ensures the safe conduct of Nozawa Onsen's fire festival in Nagano, and Andrew Mancabelli crafts Japanese armour in Warabi, Saitama.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship hourly news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Kaizoku
programme.desc: The Murakami Kaizoku were seafarers and fighters in the Seto Inland Sea - we explore their history and legacy with footage from time-lapse creator Shimizu Daisuke. This time: the Kurushima Straits.

programme.title: Bosai: Science That Can Save Your Life
programme.desc: Japan is one of the most volcanically active nations - world-leading research on volcanic disasters has led to new technologies to track underground magma and predict phreatic eruptions.

programme.title: Activate Your Japanese!
programme.desc: Learn how to make the most of your Japanese skills - watch our drama that features useful communication strategies, our snappy videos about onomatopoeia, and our documentaries on 'senpai' in Japan.

programme.title: Culture Crossroads
programme.desc: Efforts to save children have evolved in a unique way that energises people who provide services - we introduce a splendid international example of such an initiative in Matsuyama in Ehime Prefecture.

programme.title: Hello! NHK World-Japan
programme.desc: In a special feature on Hokkaido, programmes looked at the ecology of brown bears, a special bento lunch, and a bountiful landscape formed by rugged natural conditions and pioneering development.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship hourly news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Seasoning the Seasons

programme.title: Australian F1 GP Highlights
programme.desc: A McLaren one-two forms the front row for the Australian Grand Prix, as Lando Norris leads from Oscar Piastri. Max Verstappen starts third, while Lewis Hamilton begins from P8. (16.03)

programme.title: Chinese F1 GP Highlights
programme.desc: It's a first Grand Prix pole for Oscar Piastri as George Russell splits the McLarens with Lando Norris starting third. Sprint winner Lewis Hamilton comes from fifth on the grid. (23.03)

programme.title: Japanese F1 GP Highlights
programme.desc: It's lights out at Suzuka for the Japanese Grand Prix. World champion Max Verstappen starts from the front of the grid with the McLaren duo of Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri behind. (06.04)

programme.title: Bahrain F1 GP Highlights
programme.desc: It's lights out for the 2025 Bahrain Grand Prix. Oscar Piastri holds pole position with his McLaren teammate Lando Norris down in P6. Charles Leclerc joins Piastri on the front row. (13.04)

programme.title: Saudi Arabian F1 GP Highlights
programme.desc: It's lights out in Jeddah for the 2025 Saudi Arabian Grand Prix. Reigning world champion Max Verstappen crossed the finish line in P1 last season at the Jeddah Corniche Circuit. (20.04)

programme.title: Miami F1 GP Highlights
programme.desc: Polesitter Max Verstappen is joined by Lando Norris and Kimi Antonelli heading into turn one, while Lewis Hamilton tries to fight through the field from P12. (04.05)

programme.title: Emilia Romagna F1 GP Highlights
programme.desc: It's lights out at Imola for the 2025 Emilia Romagna Grand Prix. Last season, reigning world champion Max Verstappen held off a late Lando Norris charge to claim race victory. (18.05)

programme.title: Monaco F1 GP Highlights
programme.desc: On the streets of Monte Carlo, the 2025 Monaco Grand Prix arrives. Lando Norris lines up in P1 with Charles Leclerc behind him as the Monegasque pursues back-to-back home wins. (25.05)

programme.title: Spanish F1 GP Highlights
programme.desc: It's an all-papaya front row as McLaren lead the way with Oscar Piastri from Lando Norris. Max Verstappen and George Russell form the second row, while Lewis Hamilton starts P5. (01.06)

programme.title: Canadian F1 GP Highlights
programme.desc: It's lights out for the Canadian Grand Prix as George Russell and Max Verstappen line-up alongside each other at the front with Oscar Piastri in third. Lando Norris comes from P7. (15.06)

programme.title: Austrian F1 GP Highlights
programme.desc: Lando Norris bounces back to take pole alongside Charles Leclerc. Oscar Piastri and Lewis Hamilton share row two, while Max Verstappen starts down in P7 for Red Bull's home race. (29.06)

programme.title: British F1 GP Highlights
programme.desc: It's lights out at Silverstone. Max Verstappen shares the front row with Oscar Piastri, while Brits Lando Norris, George Russell and Lewis Hamilton round out the top five. (06.07)

programme.title: Belgian F1 GP Highlights
programme.desc: It's lights out at Spa. With eyes on the weather, Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri lock out the front, while Charles Leclerc starts P3. Lewis Hamilton bids to fight through the field. (27.07)

programme.title: Hungarian F1 GP Highlights
programme.desc: It's lights out at the Hungaroring. As Charles Leclerc goes up against the McLarens from pole, both Max Verstappen and Lewis Hamilton face tough recovery drives from further back. (03.08)

programme.title: Dutch F1 GP Highlights
programme.desc: It's lights out in Zandvoort. Pipping his team mate to pole, Oscar Piastri leads Lando Norris as Max Verstappen looks to spring a surprise from P3 with Isack Hadjar for company. (31.08)

programme.title: Italian F1 GP Highlights
programme.desc: It's lights out at Monza. Max Verstappen holds pole from title contenders Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri as Charles Leclerc leads the Ferrari charge with Lewis Hamilton down in P10. (07.09)
